        g.assign(n, vector<Edge>());

        it.assign(n, 0);

        Edge a = {v, (int)g[v].size(), c, 0};

        g[u].push_back(a);
        g[v].push_back(b);

        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        level[s] = 0;
        q.push(s);
